title: hydrostatic-ocean-core-benchmark: code and measurement data for "Performance of a hydrostatic ocean core across computing devices and programming frameworks under verified double-precision agreement"
description: One hydrostatic Boussinesq primitive-equation ocean core (partial-cell bathymetry, implicit vertical mixing, one-equation TKE closure, third-order TVD advection) implemented five times from a single discretization document: NumPy reference, Fortran serial/OpenMP, OpenACC, CUDA and JAX. Every timed binary is gated to reproduce the reference to a relative L2 error below 1e-12 per step on the node where it is timed. The archive contains the five implementations, the discretization specification, the TOML configurations, the verification/audit/figure scripts, the experiment ledger (expr/) and the promoted measurement data behind every figure and table of the paper (paper/cases/: raw timing CSV/JSON with node, date and reproduction command, plus verification-gate logs). Code: BSD-3-Clause. Data in paper/cases/: CC BY 4.0. Bench-node addresses have been redacted from the published copies.
